The 9th month

The Month of the Quran

Ramadan is the 9th month of the Islamic calendar.

It is the month when the Holy Quran was first revealed.

Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 185, tells us that the Quran was revealed in the month of Ramadan.

Fasting

From Dawn to Sunset

Muslims fast from dawn until sunset. No food or drink during the day.

In summer, the days are long, warm and sunny.

What I wear

Soft and Comfy Clothes

I wear my Omani dishdasha and my kumma.

They are soft, cool and comfy on warm Ramadan days.
